description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudioPlayer's miscellaneous functions, including play, pause, setEos, setVolume, and getVolume, using Google Test framework. It tests interactions with a mock GstPlayer and verifies thread synchronization and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: RialtoServerWebAudioPlayerMiscellaneousFunctionsTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from WebAudioPlayerTestBase, providing setup and utility functions for testing WebAudioPlayer's miscellaneous functions.

methods.name: notifyApiCalled
methods.description: Sets a flag and notifies condition variable to signal that an API call has been made.

methods.name: waitForApiCalled
methods.description: Waits for the notifyApiCalled signal with a timeout, asserting success.
